deviation: Payment term is 15 days from receipt of a valid invoice, half the 30-day minimum the playbook allows and well short of the 45-day standard. Interest is also at the maximum legal rate rather than capped at 1% per month, and the Supplier can suspend Services for overdue amounts, which are both worse than the standard.

4.3 The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days of receipt of a valid invoice, by electronic transfer to the account nominated by the Supplier.

4.5 Without prejudice to its other rights, the Supplier may charge interest on overdue undisputed amounts from the due date until payment at a rate not exceeding 1% per month. [Supplier's right to suspend Services to be deleted, or limited to undisputed amounts remaining unpaid 30 days after written notice of non-payment.]
